This case-sensitive code system http://hl7belgium.org/fhir/patient-monitoring/CodeSystem/decision-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
administration Medication administeredMedication could be administered according to the procedure.
no-administration Medication NOT administeredMedication was not administered due to contraindications.
other OtherA different outcome was agreed upon after consultation with the hospital care team.

name: DecisionCS
title: Medication Administration Decision Codes
description: Local codes for the nurse's decision following contraindication assessment in ONCO home-hospitalization questionnaires.
